lede: The clearest signal on Saturday was one project showing up in two places at once: morluto/rea, an agent tool that reverse engineers software down to native binaries, topped GitHub trending with 14,927 stars in a day and sat second on Hacker News. The largest raw number of the day belonged to Counter-Strike 2, which held 1,244,028 players at once on Steam. Hacker News gave Cloudflare's acquisition of Deno 1,131 points, and Wikipedia's most-read article was Nidal Hasan at 787,247 views.
